snippet.title: Bastion Rivals - Official Gameplay Trailer | Coming Soon on Steam
snippet.description:
Wishlist Bastion Rivals on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5423790/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=launch_20261101

Build the army. Break the bastion.

Command a builder, grow your economy and create armies that march and fight automatically across two lanes. Choose the Iron Covenant, Redfang Clans, Hollow Court or Verdant Oath, combine troop producers and turn the siege with counters, spells, items and upgrades.

Practice solo against AI in 1v1, 2v2 and 3v3 setups. Ranked and unranked online 1v1/2v2, leaderboards and community tournaments are planned for launch. Designed for mouse and keyboard on Windows.

Target release: 14 January 2027, subject to final Steam approval. Follow the Steam page for confirmed release news.

This trailer uses arranged in-engine footage captured from the native Windows game. It is not a live multiplayer match or a performance benchmark.

Developed and published by Rasmus Rowbotham.

Music: "Clash Defiant" by Kevin MacLeod
https://incompetech.com/
Licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0:
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Edited and mixed. ISRC USUAN1600003.

#BastionRivals #StrategyGames #IndieGame Inspiration & thanks
Bastion Rivals is inspired by Castle Fight, the Warcraft III custom map originally created by geX (also known as gekko). Special thanks to geX and the Castle Fight community for the inspiration and years of castle battles.
